title: Potential progression biomarkers of diabetic kidney disease determined using comprehensive machine learning analysis of non-targeted metabolomics
summary: Longitudinal diabetic-kidney-disease metabolomics analysis used explainable machine learning to identify candidate progression biomarkers; these remain candidates, not validated clinical markers. The longitudinal analysis identifies candidate biomarkers; it does not establish causal mechanisms or clinical validation.
organization: The University of Tokyo Graduate School of Medicine

evidence.tested: Longitudinal diabetic-kidney-disease metabolomics analysis used explainable machine learning to identify candidate progression biomarkers; these remain candidates, not validated clinical markers.
evidence.unknown: The longitudinal analysis identifies candidate biomarkers; it does not establish causal mechanisms or clinical validation. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Analyzes longitudinal metabolomics data to identify candidate biomarkers associated with diabetic-kidney-disease progression.
